facts.title: All Online Tools in One Box | 10015 Tools
facts.description: All online tools you need in one box for free. Build anything online with “all-in-one toolbox”. All tools are easy-to-use, blazing fast & free.

research.name: 10015 Tools
research.note: Free web toolbox bundling text, image, PDF, CSS, color and social mockup generators in one site.
unverified: No dated changelog or release entry was found; the homepage marks PDF Editor as NEW without a date, so lastUpdated is left empty.
No GitHub link was found on the site; openSource false is based on that absence, not on a repository search.
